title: Mortgage Bridging Loans UK & London
summary: Service page for Silver Oak Capital's UK bridging loans, with a stated London focus. Search results (titles + search-tool summaries) confirm the page title 'Mortgage Bridging Loans UK & London' and describe short-term property bridging loans for homeowners, investors and developers, approvals quoted at 5-14 days, same-day indicative terms, rapid completions across the UK and London, and rates sourced from specialist UK bridging lenders. The seed snippet adds: loans typically set up for 12 to 24 months, secured on property, interest rolled up (no affordability check), principal and interest repaid as one sum on expiry via refinance or sale, and a '700+ Lenders' claim. No H1, meta description, LTV, rate, fee or process-step text from this page itself was surfaced; the page body could not be fetched directly.

sections.heading: Bridging loans UK wide, London focus (page positioning)
sections.content: [a][b][seed] The page positions Silver Oak Capital as providing bridging loans UK wide with a particular focus on the London property market, aimed at homeowners, investors and developers. [a] It describes short-term property bridging loans and presents London as a particular strength.

sections.heading: Speed: approvals and indicative terms
sections.content: [a] Search-tool summary of the page's description: approvals quoted at 5-14 days and same-day indicative terms with rapid completions across the UK and London property market. [b] Second search independently reports the page 'advertises approvals in 5-14 days'.

sections.heading: Common uses
sections.content: [b][seed] Buying a new property before selling your current one, funding a renovation, or covering a short-term cash flow gap.

sections.heading: How the loan is structured
sections.content: [seed] Loans typically set up for 12 to 24 months and secured on property; interest is rolled up rather than paid monthly, so no affordability check is needed; principal and interest repaid as one sum on expiry, usually via refinancing or sale. [b] A separate Silver Oak guide (page not identified by the search tool) says terms generally run between 1 and 24 months and that interest costs are generally higher than traditional finance, though interest can be rolled up.

sections.heading: Lender panel
sections.content: [a] The page says the firm sources rates from specialist UK bridging lenders. [seed] The page cites '700+ Lenders'. Neither of the three searches repeated a lender count.

sections.heading: Loan sizes (from other Silver Oak pages surfaced alongside)
sections.content: [a] /lenders/: generally focus[es] on transactions upwards of £500,000. [a] /commercial-mortgage-broker/: focuses on larger loan sizes of £2-£20 million. [b] HNW bridging guide: the firm's lenders offer loans from as little as £10,000 and are especially flexible for borrowers borrowing over £2,000,000. The search tool itself flagged that these thresholds differ.

sections.heading: Related bridging case studies surfaced
sections.content: [a] £3.6 Million Bridging Loan, prime Kensington property: finance arranged after two specialist lenders had previously withdrawn at the final stage. [b] NW London Bridging Loan: £19 million bridging loan at a 0.75% monthly rate over 12 months, arranged for a North West London development. [a] Trade press (bridgingandcommercial.co.uk, 2020): 'Silver Oak Capital completes its largest ever bridging loan of £19.1m' (described by the search tool as a refinance).
